name: logistics-aggregator-portal
description: Comprehensive logistics management solution for India

scripts.stop:all: docker-compose --profile all-services down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.frontend.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.backend.yml --profile future-services down && docker stop $(docker ps -q --filter name=logistics-) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:all: docker-compose --profile all-services down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.frontend.yml down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.backend.yml --profile future-services down -v && docker stop $(docker ps -q --filter name=logistics-) 2>/dev/null || true && docker system prune -f
scripts.restart:all: pnpm run stop:all && pnpm run dev
scripts.prisma:studio: docker-compose exec auth-service npx prisma studio
scripts.migrate:deploy: docker-compose exec auth-service pnpm run migrate:deploy && docker-compose exec user-service pnpm run migrate:deploy && docker-compose exec wallet-service pnpm run migrate:deploy && docker-compose exec license-service pnpm run migrate:deploy
scripts.migrate:deploy:all: for service in auth-service user-service wallet-service shipment-service partner-service support-service platform-service license-service; do docker-compose exec $service pnpm run migrate:deploy 2>/dev/null || echo "Skipping $service (no migrations or not running)"; done
scripts.db:seed: for service in auth-service user-service wallet-service shipment-service partner-service support-service platform-service license-service; do echo "Seeding $service..."; docker-compose exec -T $service pnpm run db:seed 2>/dev/null || echo "No seed file for $service"; done
scripts.db:seed:auth: docker-compose exec auth-service pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed:user: docker-compose exec user-service pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed:wallet: docker-compose exec wallet-service pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed:partner: docker-compose exec partner-service pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:seed:shipment: docker-compose exec shipment-service pnpm run db:seed
scripts.fresh:install: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm run setup:dev
scripts.fresh:install:win: pnpm run cleanup:win && pnpm run setup:dev:win
scripts.fresh:frontend: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm run setup:frontend
scripts.fresh:frontend:win: pnpm run cleanup:win && pnpm run setup:frontend:win
scripts.fresh:backend: pnpm run cleanup && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.fresh:backend:win: pnpm run cleanup:win && pnpm run setup:backend:win
scripts.secure:build: cd tools/secure-docker-builder && npm install && node src/cli.js build
scripts.secure:generate-config: cd tools/secure-docker-builder && npm install && node src/cli.js generate-config
scripts.prisma:license: docker-compose exec license-service npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:license:deploy: docker-compose exec license-service npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:license:studio: docker-compose exec license-service npx prisma studio

author: Logistics Development Team
